# Mistgate

> Self-hosted VPN fleet panel and Go node agent. The panel and node agent are static Go binaries; no Docker runtime is required.

## Start here

- [AI agent guide](https://mistgate.app/getting-started/ai-agents/): ready prompts to install the panel over SSH, run the fleet through owner-approved MCP tools, and contribute.
- [Documentation map](https://mistgate.app/): English docs; `/ru/` is Russian.
- [Install the panel](https://mistgate.app/getting-started/install-panel/)
- [Install a node over SSH](https://mistgate.app/getting-started/ssh-install/)
- [Add a node manually](https://mistgate.app/getting-started/add-node/)
- [MCP server and tool contracts](https://mistgate.app/reference/mcp/)
- [API reference](https://mistgate.app/reference/api/)
- [Updates](https://mistgate.app/operations/updates/) and [releases and signing](https://mistgate.app/operations/releases/)
- [Status and roadmap](https://mistgate.app/roadmap/status/)
- [Repository agent instructions](https://github.com/Mistgate/mistgate/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Mistgate/mistgate)

## Language

- English: https://mistgate.app/
- Russian: https://mistgate.app/ru/
